name: Daily Maintenance — Captain
source: KB: squid-on-board-binder / §6 Captain SQUID Daily and Monthly Maintenance — Captain's DMT
intro: One task per day, about 15 minutes. Check today's day and complete the matching task. These daily tasks keep the boat safe and in top condition.

help.title: Bilge inspection details
help.body: Inspect bilge pumps and screen. Remove debris, dewater, degrease, degrime, clean gutters. Repair or clean where necessary.

help.title: Machine space inspection details
help.body: Go INTO the machine space and ensure there is nothing wet and gross, or personal items being stored there. This space must stay clean and functional.

items.label: Wednesday: Add steering fluid and realign motors

help.title: Steering maintenance
help.body: Top off steering fluid. Check motor alignment and realign if necessary. If steering felt spongy or skippy during the day, this is especially important.

items.label: Thursday: Overhead wipe down — clean under roof area by helm
Friday: Tidy up/clean helm area, storage space in helm, underbenches

help.title: Stainless care
help.body: Use Fitz cleaning solution and terry towel on all stainless steel surfaces.

items.label: Sunday: Salt-Away Sunday — flush and rinse motors/sugar scoop area with salt-away

help.title: Salt-Away procedure
help.body: Flush and rinse motors and sugar scoop area using salt-away solution. This weekly salt treatment prevents corrosion buildup.

completion.notes_prompt: Only check today's task. Any issues found during maintenance? Parts or supplies needed?
